# Z Index

10 tokens in the `z-index` group.

| Token | Type | Value | CSS Variable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `z-index.0` | `number` | `0` | `--rw-z-index-0` | Base stacking level |
| `z-index.10` | `number` | `100` | `--rw-z-index-10` | Low stacking level |
| `z-index.20` | `number` | `200` | `--rw-z-index-20` | Raised stacking level |
| `z-index.30` | `number` | `300` | `--rw-z-index-30` | Elevated stacking level |
| `z-index.40` | `number` | `400` | `--rw-z-index-40` | High stacking level |
| `z-index.50` | `number` | `500` | `--rw-z-index-50` | Overlay stacking level |
| `z-index.60` | `number` | `600` | `--rw-z-index-60` | Modal stacking level |
| `z-index.70` | `number` | `700` | `--rw-z-index-70` | Popover stacking level |
| `z-index.80` | `number` | `800` | `--rw-z-index-80` | Toast stacking level |
| `z-index.90` | `number` | `900` | `--rw-z-index-90` | Topmost stacking level |
